senses.gloss: (contr. of על דרבה, v. אַדְּ־) turn to the stronger side, whence as a dialectic term, on the contrary.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 28a:7">Pes. 28ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>א׳ איפכא מסתברא</he> on the contrary, the reverse stands to reason.

<cite ref="Pesachim 77a:10">Ib. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה אמינא א׳</he> I might have said, ‘On the contrary’ &c.; a. fr. [Not to be confounded with <cite ref="A00449"><he>אַדְּרָבָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="A00449"><he>אַדְּרַבָּה</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="A00367"><he>אַדְּ־</he></cite>.]
